Fabrics are the part of a sofa that meets the weather every day.

## Care basics

Vacuum the whole sofa once a week and blot spills the moment they happen.

### Vacuuming

A brush head and a light hand are enough.

## Where the sofa sits

Keep a little gap between the sofa and an external wall so air can move. See the [fabric sofas](/sofas/fabric/) we make.
